_comment: Capitals: the ten towns on the map (data/settlements.json), written into server/world/world.json by scripts/tools/export_server_world.gd. A faction's capital town (factions.json `capital`) is level 2, every other town level 1. A town guard (`guard` soldiers: base * growth^(level - 1), mixed as `guard_armies`) holds each one behind strong walls (palisade_base + palisade_per_level * (level - 1)) until someone beats them. Whoever takes a town gets `yields` (per hour, base * yield_growth^(level - 1), stored up to store_hours) and every castle of the holder's alliance (online; only the holder offline) produces `bonus` more of everything: bonus_base + bonus_per_level * (level - 1) per capital, at most max_bonus in all. Your keep must reach min_keep to take one; a player holds at most per_player capitals and an alliance at most per_alliance. A capital just taken can't be attacked for peace_hours.
